headline: The Blind Spot Beneath Our Cities
bullets: Underground assets — sewers, tunnels, cables, foundations — fail silently
Defects surface only after collapse, with catastrophic cost and risk
Most operators are reactive: they discover problems when it's too late to act cheaply

headline: The EDGE Digital Twin
bullets: Continuous sensor fusion + geotechnical modelling of live assets
Automated anomaly detection flags movement, leakage, and drift early
Real-time twin lets engineers see risk emerge — not after the event

headline: Measurable Impact
bullets: Up to 40% lower unplanned intervention cost
Days of early-warning lead time on critical defects
Reduced OPEX and avoided shutdowns and safety incidents
